title: The Rape of the Lock, and Other Poems
sourceTitle: The Rape of the Lock, and Other Poems
author: Alexander Pope
description: "The Rape of the Lock, and Other Poems" by Alexander Pope is a mock-heroic narrative poem first published in 1712.
longDescription: This celebrated example of high burlesque transforms a trivial social incident—a nobleman secretly snipping a lock of a young lady's hair—into an elaborate epic parody complete with supernatural guardians and classical conventions.

authorInfo.bio: Alexander Pope (1688–1744) wrote The Rape of the Lock, and Other Poems. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
